title: KTEQ 55
body:
# 2026 - 1971 = 55

Since 1971, KTEQ 91.3 FM has been the student voice of South Dakota Mines. That's fifty-five years of FCC logs, dead air panic, local concerts, heaps of promo mail, and music and memories that students carried with them long after graduation.

That's a lot of history to share.  We need your help to recover as much of it as possible. 

## What we're building
For our 55th anniversary, we're creating a living archive of KTEQ's history — one that future students can learn from, build on, and add to. Here's what that looks like:

- A yearbook section on kteq.org documenting the station's story year by year — the people, the music, the moments. Not a dusty museum piece, though we do have a few of those, but an evolving record that connects KTEQ's past to its present.

- A Throwback Thursday series on social media walking through the station's history from 1971 to today, one year at a time.

- Anniversary music blocks on the air pulling from the sounds that defined different eras of the station — music that shaped KTEQ's identity re-introduced to today's listeners to help everyone understand what independent radio sounded like to the people who helped shape it at various points in time.

The goal is a station that works as both a new music discovery platform and a re-discovery platform — where the music, stories, and culture serve as the foundation for what comes next, instead of something every new group of students has to reinvent from scratch.

## What we need from you

If you were part of KTEQ — as a DJ, a station manager, an engineer —  or if KTEQ is a part of you, we want to hear from you.
- **Music:** Send us links to high-quality files, recordings of old shows, albums recommendations, or requests that defined your time at the station. We're building a catalog that bridges eras, and your contributions will shape what goes on the air and into the archive.
- **Memories:** Stories, photos, old playlists, flyers, stickers, station logs — anything that helps document what KTEQ was during your years. A quote, a snapshot, a paragraph — it all counts.
- **News & Programming:** We're a non-commercial educational radio station that's always looking for content ideas that to help us serve our education programming mission. Let us know if you can contribute stories of your experiences for an alumni spotlight program.  
- **Moolah.** Funding for student activities is shrinking. If you'd like to help fund equipment maintenance, studio and broadcast upgrades, paid student positions, and live music events, just click the **Donate** button at the top of the page. Stay tuned for matching gift opportunities this summer. Every bit helps us build something that lasts.

The easiest way to contribute is to email us at hello@kteq.org with whatever you've got. Even if it's just a name and a year and a story you half-remember — send it. We'll take it from there. 

## What's ahead
The anniversary campaign runs through September, when we'll celebrate with a grand reopening and live event during M-Week. Between now and then, keep an eye on our social channels for the Throwback Thursdays and #KTEQ55, and watch this space for updates as the yearbook grows.

Fifty-five years is worth remembering. Help us prepare for the next fifty-five years.
